title: Kellie NDE 7673
content: I was at a party, and a guy told me he had some weed that was special. I'm not a weed smoker, but he was cute. I remember smoking a little, then getting up to walk, and then nothing. Suddenly, I was floating above myself; up against the ceiling like a balloon, and then softly bumping the ceiling. I could hear people talking, like my hands were cupped over my ears. I really remember the parts in people's hair, straight down the middle, but I couldn't see faces. One girl was trying to help me and was very upset. She said, 'She's not breathing, somebody help her!' While watching this, I was very calm and peaceful. I did not know the girl. I felt grateful that she cared. I had a sense of affection for her and her caring about me. I heard someone say, 'She's wet her pants.' Not caring at all, I was only curious about what I could see. Then suddenly, like suction, I was back in my body! My hearing came back. It went from muffled to normal during the suctioning back to my body. I could feel myself again and was affected by gravity. I felt heavy. A friend helped me up and took me outside for air. I was unconcerned about what had happened. I didn't feel 'high.' I thought about what happened. I was worried that if I had died, that I would have been trapped in the house forever, like a ghost. I went home, went to bed, and didn't tell anyone for about 20 years.

out_of_body.separation_sensations_other: Felt like a balloon, softly bumping the ceiling; calm and peaceful.

boundary_and_return.return_method_other_detail: Suddenly returned to body 'like suction'; hearing changed from muffled to normal during return.

context.nde_cause_other_detail: Smoked 'special' weed at a party; then collapsed/unresponsive and observed self not breathing.

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: Muffled hearing during OBE; return described as 'suction' back into body; no tunnel/light/life review/boundary.
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: OBE occurred, then abrupt involuntary return; no other canonical stages described.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: Auditory perception described as muffled ('like my hands were cupped over my ears'); visual detail focused on hair parts but not faces; concern afterward about being trapped as a ghost in the house if she had died; did not tell anyone for about 20 years.
unique_elements.notable_quotes: “She's not breathing, somebody help her!” / “She's wet her pants.” / “Then suddenly, like suction, I was back in my body!”
